litSearch.title: Literature search
litSearch.subtitle: Paste a study description including hypothesis, objectives, and methods. The system will search PubMed for alternatives.
litSearch.placeholder:
Include:
• Scientific hypothesis — what question is this study answering?
• Objectives — what outcomes are measured?
• Detailed methods — species, procedure, duration, guideline followed

Example: We hypothesize that compound X causes acute dermal irritation. The objective is to determine its irritation potential for REACH registration. Wistar rats (n=10) will receive occlusive patch application of 0.5 mL/kg for 4 hours under OECD TG 404...
